list.name: serial
list.label: Drive serial
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "telegraf", tag: "serial", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "kvbench_nvme", start: -30d)

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "telegraf", tag: "run_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "kvbench_nvme" and r.serial =~ /^${serial:regex}$/, start: -30d)

options.content: **WAF = ΔNAND bytes / Δhost bytes.** Device-wide counters, not KV submitted bytes or lifetime ratios. Host SMART units are 512,000 B; the OCP physical-media counter is bytes. No WAF point is emitted with zero host writes. Idle NAND writes remain visible. Select one drive and run. Compare only qualified high-occupancy, multiple-drive-fill runs; monitor data is not a benchmark result. Missing samples, resets, firmware/serial changes invalidate run WAF. File traces describe file operations, not LBA sequentiality.

panels.title: Host and NAND bytes written (device lifetime counters)

targets.query: from(bucket: "telegraf") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kvbench_nvme" and r.serial =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ and r.run_id =~ /^${run:regex}$/ and (r._field == "host_bytes_total" or r._field == "nand_bytes_total")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telegraf") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kvbench_nvme" and r.serial =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ and r.run_id =~ /^${run:regex}$/ and (r._field == "host_bytes_per_second" or r._field == "nand_bytes_per_second")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Interval WAF — ratio of summed byte deltas

targets.query: from(bucket: "telegraf") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kvbench_nvme" and r.serial =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ and r.run_id =~ /^${run:regex}$/ and (r._field == "host_bytes_delta" or r._field == "nand_bytes_delta")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.host_bytes_delta and exists r.nand_bytes_delta and r.host_bytes_delta > 0.0) |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.nand_bytes_delta / r.host_bytes_delta, _field: "WAF"})) |> drop(columns: ["host_bytes_delta", "nand_bytes_delta"])

panels.title: Cumulative run WAF (includes idle GC within the run)

targets.query: from(bucket: "telegraf") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kvbench_nvme" and r.serial =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ and r.run_id =~ /^${run:regex}$/ and r._field == "waf_run") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telegraf") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kvbench_nvme" and r.serial =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ and r.run_id =~ /^${run:regex}$/ and r._field == "drive_fills") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telegraf") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kvbench_nvme" and r.serial =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ and r.run_id =~ /^${run:regex}$/ and r._field == "occupancy") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Telemetry validity (1 = valid; gaps are not zero WAF)

targets.query: from(bucket: "telegraf") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kvbench_nvme" and r.serial =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ and r.run_id =~ /^${run:regex}$/ and (r._field == "sample_valid" or r._field == "run_valid")) |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0})) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
